English.CREATURE_STORY_14:
Maya was born in a hunting village on the edge of Orvel's great northern forest, where children learn to read tracks before they learn to read letters. Her mother was the village's finest hunter, and her father carved the curved throwing blades that the villagers used to bring down birds on the wing. Maya inherited both gifts. By fifteen she could throw a boomerang through a gap between two branches and catch it again without looking.
That same year she found a wounded cub tangled in a poacher's net: a strange beast with teal fur, a fiery mane and a tail that ended in a hard, spear-like spike. Beside the net lay his mother, felled by poisoned arrows. The poachers came back for their prize. Maya drove them off with nothing but her blades and her voice, then spent a whole winter nursing the cub in a hunter's hut. She named him Seves, "the one who stays", because when spring came and the forest called, he did not leave her side.
Seves grew far larger than any beast the villagers knew, and some of them began to whisper that the creature would turn on them one day. Maya chose to leave rather than see her partner caged. Since then the two have wandered Orvel as hunters for hire, clearing monster nests from roads and farmland and selling what they catch to merchants (though Maya will warn you which of it tastes terrible). She forged gold-trimmed armor for Seves from the scales of a drake they brought down together, and wears a hunter's helm carved from the same horns.
Maya is blunt, proud and fiercely loyal. She has little patience for nobles who call Seves a "pet" or for anyone who treats the forest as something to be emptied. In battle the pair move as one: Maya's boomerangs open wounds, and Seves finishes what she starts. People call her a beastmaster; Maya simply calls Seves family.

English.ITEM_STORY_1014: A pair of hooked boomerangs carved from the claws of Seves's mother. They always return to Maya's hand, and the wounds they leave never close cleanly.
English.ITEM_STORY_103014: A flat river stone worn smooth by years of sharpening. Maya never throws a boomerang she has not honed on it herself.
English.ITEM_STORY_102014: Carved from a hollow antler. Its note is too low for human ears, but Seves hears it from the far side of a mountain.
English.ITEM_STORY_101014: Seves's first milk tooth, bound in silver thread. Maya swears it has turned more than one arrow aside.
English.ITEM_STORY_104014: A beaded leather band Maya wears on her wrist. Seves has its twin, and neither of them has ever taken it off.

English.ITEM_STORY_111014: Fenra, the first beast that ever hunted, sleeps within this stone. It answers only those who hunt beside a partner they would die for.
English.INN_MAYA_INNIDLE01: Seves is napping by the fire again. Don't wake him unless you want your hand licked... or bitten.
English.INN_MAYA_GREETING01: Oh, it's you. Seves remembered your scent before I remembered your face.
English.INN_MAYA_GREETING02: Welcome back. We saved you a seat. Well, Seves is lying on it, but it's yours.
English.INN_MAYA_CONVERSATION01: City folk always ask if Seves bites. Only poachers. And people who call him a pet.
English.INN_MAYA_CONVERSATION02: My father carved my first boomerang. It came back crooked, so I threw it until it didn't.
English.INN_MAYA_CONVERSATION03: The forest isn't a pantry. Take what you need, and leave the rest to grow.
English.INN_MAYA_CONVERSATION04: Seves was so small when I found him. Now he carries me across rivers. Life's funny like that.
English.INN_MAYA_CONVERSATION05: If you ever want to learn to track, come hunting with us. Just keep quiet. Seves hates chatter.
English.INN_MAYA_GIFT01: For me? ...Seves likes it. That means I like it too.
English.INN_MAYA_GIFT02: You remembered what we like. Fine, you can scratch behind his ears. Just this once.
English.INN_MAYA_CONNECT_GREETING_MAX: You're pack now. Seves decided that ages ago. I'm just catching up.
English.INN_MAYA_CONNECT_CONVERSATION01: When I left my village, I thought it would always be just the two of us. I'm glad I was wrong.
English.INN_MAYA_CONNECT_CONVERSATION02: If anyone ever tries to cage you, call for us. Seves can hear that whistle from across a mountain.
English.INN_MAYA_CONNECT_CONVERSATION03: Family isn't blood. It's who comes back for you. Remember that, all right?
English.SOULWEAPON_STORY_14:
Maya always believed the claws of Seves's mother were only a keepsake: sharp, true and silent. But on the night a poacher's arrow struck Seves down in the snow, the boomerangs grew warm in her hands, and she heard a low growl that came from no living throat.
'-You kept my child alive. Now I will keep you both.'
It was Fenra, the first beast that ever hunted, who had slept within the claws since before Orvel had a name. From that night on, whenever Maya and Seves hunt as one, a shadow with teal fur and a burning mane runs a step ahead of them, and no prey has ever outrun it.
